name: 76262 · Roanoke, TX
findings: ZIP 76262 (Roanoke) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76262 (Roanoke) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76262 (Roanoke) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
